automaticCounterspell.name: Counterspell
automaticCounterspell.rangeAndTarget: One creature you perceive casting a spell within 60 feet
automaticCounterspell.effect: Counterspell. Tags: arch-source, automatic, wizard-spell, abjuration, disruption. Trigger when a creature begins casting a spell. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell's rank, treating rank 0 as 0. Success negates the triggering spell after its costs are paid; failure lets it resolve.
